datasets.name: p1_top_death_causes
datasets.displayName: P1 Top causes of registered deaths 2023–2024 (PSA)
queryLines:
-- Top 10 causes of registered deaths, Philippines, 2023 vs 2024.
-- Source: public_health.gold.v_disease_metric_totals
--   source_dataset = 'psa_deaths_region_annual', geographic_level = 'country'
--   (one country roll-up row per cause per year; is_complete_year = true for both years).
-- Level: PSA tabulation-list causes only.
--   * all_causes excluded.
--   * The 19 ICD-chapter group headers (psa_1_001, 026, 048, 051, 055, 058, 062, 063,
--     064, 072, 078, 082, 083, 084, 087, 092, 093, 094, 095) excluded.
--   * Sub-causes excluded: letter-suffixed codes (psa_1_096a..d) and the COVID-19
--     breakdown codes (children of psa_covid19); psa_covid19 itself is kept at cause level.
--   * Catch-all names ('All other...', 'Remainder of...', 'Other...') excluded from the top-10 ranking only.
-- value_status = 'ok' only. Nulls stay null (suppressed/not available is never 0).
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    disease_name,
    year,
    SUM(value) AS total_deaths,
    MAX(is_preliminary) AS is_preliminary
  FROM
    v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'psa_deaths_region_annual'
    AND geographic_level = 'country'
    AND metric_name = 'deaths'
    AND value_status = 'ok'
    AND year IN (2023, 2024)
    AND disease_code <> 'all_causes'
    AND disease_code NOT IN (
      'psa_1_001',
      'psa_1_026',
      'psa_1_048',
      'psa_1_051',
      'psa_1_055',
      'psa_1_058',
      'psa_1_062',
      'psa_1_063',
      'psa_1_064',
      'psa_1_072',
      'psa_1_078',
      'psa_1_082',
      'psa_1_083',
      'psa_1_084',
      'psa_1_087',
      'psa_1_092',
      'psa_1_093',
      'psa_1_094',
      'psa_1_095'
    )
    AND disease_code NOT RLIKE '^psa_1_[0-9]{3}[a-z]$'
    AND disease_code NOT IN (
      'psa_covid19_vaccine_adverse_effects',
      'psa_covid19_virus_identified',
      'psa_covid19_virus_not_identified',
      'psa_mis_covid19',
      'psa_post_covid19_condition'
    )
  GROUP BY
    disease_name,
    year
),
latest AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(year) AS latest_yr
  FROM
    yearly
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT
    disease_name
  FROM
    yearly,
    latest
  WHERE
    year = latest_yr
    AND disease_name NOT LIKE 'All other%'
    AND disease_name NOT LIKE 'Remainder of%'
    AND disease_name NOT LIKE 'Other %'
  ORDER BY
    total_deaths DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  y.disease_name,
  CAST(y.year AS STRING) AS year_label,
  y.total_deaths,
  y.is_preliminary,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN y.year = l.latest_yr THEN y.total_deaths
    END
  ) OVER (PARTITION BY y.disease_name) AS sort_value
FROM
  yearly y CROSS JOIN latest l
WHERE
  y.disease_name IN (
    SELECT
      disease_name
    FROM
      top10
  )
ORDER BY
  y.disease_name,
  y.year

datasets.name: p1_ihme_burden
datasets.displayName: P1 IHME modelled burden by province (latest year)
queryLines:
-- Modelled burden (IHME GBD) per province and NCR, latest available year (2023).
-- Source: public_health.gold.v_disease_metric_totals, source_dataset = 'ihme_gbd'.
--   is_preferred_source = true keeps province rows + the NCR region row and excludes
--   superseded 'historical_province' rows, so provinces are never double-counted.
--   geographic_level IN ('province', 'region'): the only preferred region rows are NCR.
-- Area names joined via area_coverage_map (allowed) — the map is keyed per area_key,
-- so it is deduplicated to one row per area_key before joining.
-- Modelled values: value is the estimate; value_lower/value_upper are the uncertainty
-- interval, shown as error bars. Nulls are never 0.
-- One row per (province, disease, metric); 'Ischemic heart disease' is the default chart filter.
WITH names AS (
  SELECT
    area_key,
    MAX(area_name) AS area_name
  FROM
    area_coverage_map
  GROUP BY
    area_key
),
latest AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(year) AS latest_yr
  FROM
    v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'ihme_gbd'
)
SELECT
  v.disease_name,
  n.area_name AS province_name,
  v.metric_name,
  v.value,
  v.value_lower,
  v.value_upper
FROM
  v_disease_metric_totals v
    JOIN names n
      ON v.area_key = n.area_key
    CROSS JOIN latest l
WHERE
  v.source_dataset = 'ihme_gbd'
  AND v.is_preferred_source = true
  AND v.value_status = 'ok'
  AND v.geographic_level IN ('province', 'region')
  AND v.year = l.latest_yr
ORDER BY
  v.value DESC

datasets.name: p1_dengue_seasonality
datasets.displayName: P1 Dengue seasonality by month (DOH FOI)
queryLines:
-- Dengue cases by month, Philippines, 2021–2025.
-- Source: public_health.gold.v_disease_metric_totals, source_dataset = 'doh_foi_dengue'.
--   Only region-level monthly rows exist in this source (no country row), so the national
--   total is the sum over all regions — nothing is invented.
--   period_label format 'YYYY-Mnn' (calendar month) → month number parsed from position 7-8.
--   2021–2024 are complete years; 2025 covers January–September only (9 months).
-- value_status = 'ok'; nulls stay null (never 0).
SELECT
  year,
  CAST(SUBSTR(period_label, 7, 2) AS INT) AS month_num,
  CASE CAST(SUBSTR(period_label, 7, 2) AS INT)
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Jan'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Feb'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Mar'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Apr'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Jun'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Jul'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'Aug'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'Sep'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'Oct'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'Nov'
    WHEN 12 THEN 'Dec'
  END AS month_name,
  SUM(value) AS total_cases
FROM
  v_disease_metric_totals
WHERE
  source_dataset = 'doh_foi_dengue'
  AND metric_name = 'cases'
  AND value_status = 'ok'
  AND is_preferred_source = true
GROUP BY
  year,
  SUBSTR(period_label, 7, 2)
ORDER BY
  year,
  month_num

datasets.name: p1_philhealth_claims
datasets.displayName: P1 PhilHealth claims paid by province (latest full year)
queryLines:
-- PhilHealth claims paid by province, latest full year (2025).
-- Source: public_health.gold.v_disease_metric_totals,
--   source_dataset = 'philhealth_foi_claims_hospital', metric_name = 'claims_paid'.
--   coverage_basis = 'facility_location_province_excl_huc': claims are attributed to the
--   hospital's province (highly urbanized cities are separate PhilHealth areas), NOT the
--   patient's residence. Use as aggregates only.
--   value_status = 'ok': suppressed cells (very small counts) are excluded, never zeroed.
--   is_complete_year = true for every year 2016–2025 → latest full year = 2025.
--   Note: amounts are not comparable across 2024 (case-rate values changed); claim COUNTS
--   are shown here.
-- Package = PhilHealth case-rate package (disease_name); the suffix is stripped for display.
WITH names AS (
  SELECT
    area_key,
    MAX(area_name) AS area_name
  FROM
    area_coverage_map
  GROUP BY
    area_key
),
ph_latest AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(year) AS latest_yr
  FROM
    v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'philhealth_foi_claims_hospital'
    AND metric_name = 'claims_paid'
    AND is_complete_year = true
    AND value_status = 'ok'
)
SELECT
  REPLACE(v.disease_name, ' (PhilHealth case-rate package)', '') AS package_name,
  n.area_name AS province_name,
  v.year,
  v.value AS claims_paid
FROM
  v_disease_metric_totals v
    JOIN names n
      ON v.area_key = n.area_key
    CROSS JOIN ph_latest l
WHERE
  v.source_dataset = 'philhealth_foi_claims_hospital'
  AND v.metric_name = 'claims_paid'
  AND v.coverage_basis = 'facility_location_province_excl_huc'
  AND v.value_status = 'ok'
  AND v.is_preferred_source = true
  AND v.is_complete_year = true
  AND v.year = l.latest_yr
ORDER BY
  v.value DESC

datasets.name: kpi_need
datasets.displayName: P1 KPI row: need indicators (current vs prior year)
queryLines:
-- P1 KPI row: one row per tile with current value, prior-year value and % change.
-- Structure per user-supplied SQL (cur/prev UNION ALL), with three filter corrections that
-- match the verified gold2 data (see p1_counter_* datasets):
--   * psa_deaths_region_annual country rows have is_preferred_source = FALSE -> filter dropped
--   * doh_foi_dengue has NO country rows (region-monthly only) -> national = sum over regions
--     with is_preferred_source = true
--   * value_status = 'ok' everywhere (suppressed rows are excluded, never zeroed)
-- pct_change is signed and pre-formatted (+x.x% / -x.x%); nulls stay null.
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT
    'registered_deaths' AS tile,
    SUM(value) AS value
  FROM
    v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'psa_deaths_region_annual'
    AND metric_name = 'deaths'
    AND disease_code = 'all_causes'
    AND geographic_level = 'country'
    AND year = 2024
    AND value_status = 'ok'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'dengue_cases',
    SUM(value)
  FROM
    v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'doh_foi_dengue'
    AND metric_name = 'cases'
    AND year = 2024
    AND value_status = 'ok'
    AND is_preferred_source
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'dengue_deaths',
    SUM(value)
  FROM
    v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'doh_foi_dengue'
    AND metric_name = 'deaths'
    AND year = 2024
    AND value_status = 'ok'
    AND is_preferred_source
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'tb_notifications',
    SUM(value)
  FROM
    v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'doh_fhsis'
    AND metric_name = 'cases'
    AND disease_code = 'tb_all_forms'
    AND geographic_level = 'country'
    AND year = 2025
    AND value_status = 'ok'
),
prev AS (
  SELECT
    'registered_deaths' AS tile,
    SUM(value) AS value
  FROM
    v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'psa_deaths_region_annual'
    AND metric_name = 'deaths'
    AND disease_code = 'all_causes'
    AND geographic_level = 'country'
    AND year = 2023
    AND value_status = 'ok'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'dengue_cases',
    SUM(value)
  FROM
    v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'doh_foi_dengue'
    AND metric_name = 'cases'
    AND year = 2023
    AND value_status = 'ok'
    AND is_preferred_source
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'dengue_deaths',
    SUM(value)
  FROM
    v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'doh_foi_dengue'
    AND metric_name = 'deaths'
    AND year = 2023
    AND value_status = 'ok'
    AND is_preferred_source
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'tb_notifications',
    SUM(value)
  FROM
    v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'doh_fhsis'
    AND metric_name = 'cases'
    AND disease_code = 'tb_all_forms'
    AND geographic_level = 'country'
    AND year = 2024
    AND value_status = 'ok'
)
SELECT
  c.tile,
  CASE c.tile
    WHEN 'registered_deaths' THEN 'Registered deaths, 2024 (PSA)'
    WHEN 'dengue_cases' THEN 'Dengue cases, 2024 (DOH, reported)'
    WHEN 'dengue_deaths' THEN 'Dengue deaths, 2024 (DOH, reported)'
    WHEN 'tb_notifications' THEN 'TB notifications, 2025 (FHSIS)'
  END AS label,
  CASE c.tile
    WHEN 'tb_notifications' THEN 'vs 2024'
    ELSE 'vs 2023'
  END AS comparison_label,
  c.value,
  p.value AS prior_value,
  CONCAT(
    CASE
      WHEN (c.value - p.value) >= 0 THEN '+'
      ELSE '-'
    END,
    ROUND(ABS((c.value - p.value) * 100.0 / p.value), 1),
    '%'
  ) AS pct_change
FROM
  cur c
    LEFT JOIN prev p
      ON p.tile = c.tile

datasets.name: kpi_access
datasets.displayName: P2 KPI row: access to early care
queryLines:
SELECT
  'no_hospital' AS tile,
  'Localities with no hospital recorded' AS label,
  count(*) AS value
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_locality_service_presence
WHERE
  NOT has_hospital_recorded
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'no_hospital_pop',
  'Residents in them (census 2024)',
  sum(population)
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_locality_service_presence
WHERE
  NOT has_hospital_recorded
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'no_primary',
  'Localities with no licensed primary care recorded',
  count(*)
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_locality_service_presence
WHERE
  NOT has_licensed_primary_care_recorded
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'no_primary_pop',
  'Residents in them (census 2024)',
  sum(population)
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_locality_service_presence
WHERE
  NOT has_licensed_primary_care_recorded

datasets.name: access_top_beds
datasets.displayName: P2 Top 20 population per recorded hospital bed
queryLines:
SELECT
  area_name,
  population,
  hospitals_recorded,
  hospital_beds,
  population_per_hospital_bed,
  population_per_licensed_primary_care
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_locality_service_presence

  hospitals_recorded > 0

  population_per_hospital_bed DESC

datasets.name: claims_per_100k
datasets.displayName: P2 PhilHealth claims paid per 100k residents (2024, hospital's province)
queryLines:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT
    area_key,
    disease_name,
    sum(value) AS claims_paid
  FROM
    public_health.gold.v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    metric_name = 'claims_paid'
    AND coverage_basis = 'facility_location_province_excl_huc'
    AND year = 2024
    AND value_status = 'ok'
  GROUP BY
    area_key,
    disease_name
),
p AS (
  SELECT
    area_key,
    value AS population
  FROM
    public_health.gold.v_area_indicator_latest
  WHERE
    indicator_name = 'population'
    AND indicator_category = 'census'
    AND is_latest_period
)
SELECT
  g.area_name,
  c.disease_name AS package,
  c.claims_paid,
  p.population,
  round(c.claims_paid / p.population * 100000, 1) AS claims_paid_per_100k
FROM
  c
    JOIN p
      ON p.area_key = c.area_key
    JOIN public_health.gold.dim_geography AS g
      ON g.area_key = c.area_key
WHERE
  p.population > 0

columns.description: Claims paid per 100,000 residents, aggregated over the selected packages (population is constant per province).

datasets.name: map_presence
datasets.displayName: P2 Locality service presence map (cities and municipalities)
queryLines:
SELECT
  l.area_key,
  l.area_name,
  g.center_lat,
  g.center_lon,
  l.population,
  l.hospitals_recorded,
  l.has_hospital_recorded,
  l.highest_hospital_level,
  l.licensed_primary_care_facilities_recorded,
  l.has_licensed_primary_care_recorded,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT l.has_hospital_recorded THEN 'No hospital recorded'
    ELSE 'Hospital recorded'
  END AS status
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_locality_service_presence AS l
    JOIN public_health.gold.dim_geography AS g
      ON g.area_key = l.area_key
WHERE
  g.center_lat IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: access_distance_hist
datasets.displayName: P2 Distance to nearest recorded hospital (10-km bins)
queryLines:
WITH binned AS (
  SELECT
    'Nearest recorded hospital' AS series,
    CASE
      WHEN nearest_hospital_locality_km >= 100 THEN 100
      ELSE FLOOR(nearest_hospital_locality_km / 10) * 10
    END AS bin_floor
  FROM
    public_health.gold.fact_area_access
  WHERE
    nearest_hospital_locality_km IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Nearest Level 3 hospital',
    CASE
      WHEN nearest_level3_locality_km >= 100 THEN 100
      ELSE FLOOR(nearest_level3_locality_km / 10) * 10
    END
  FROM
    public_health.gold.fact_area_access
  WHERE
    nearest_level3_locality_km IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  series,
  bin_floor,
  CASE
    WHEN bin_floor >= 100 THEN '100+'
    ELSE CONCAT(CAST(bin_floor AS STRING), '–', CAST(bin_floor + 10 AS STRING))
  END AS bin_label,
  COUNT(*) AS localities
FROM
  binned
GROUP BY
  series,
  bin_floor
ORDER BY
  series,
  bin_floor

datasets.name: supply_by_unit_long
datasets.displayName: P3 Supply by planning unit (long: beds by level per 10,000 residents)
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    area_name,
    unit_level,
    population,
    beds_per_10k,
    CASE
      WHEN hospitals > 0 THEN true
      ELSE false
    END AS has_hospital,
    s.lvl AS hospital_level,
    s.beds_lvl
  FROM
    public_health.gold.mart_area_service_profile
    LATERAL VIEW
      stack(3, 'Level 1', beds_level1, 'Level 2', beds_level2, 'Level 3', beds_level3) s
      AS lvl, beds_lvl
  WHERE
    beds_per_10k IS NOT NULL
    AND population > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    CASE
      WHEN
        has_hospital
      THEN
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY unit_level ORDER BY beds_per_10k DESC, area_name)
    END AS rank_top,
    CASE
      WHEN
        has_hospital
      THEN
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY unit_level ORDER BY beds_per_10k ASC, area_name)
    END AS rank_bottom
  FROM
    base b
)
SELECT
  area_name,
  unit_level,
  population,
  beds_per_10k,
  hospital_level,
  CASE
    WHEN has_hospital THEN round(beds_lvl * 10000.0 / population, 2)
  END AS beds_per_10k_level,
  has_hospital,
  CASE
    WHEN rank_top <= 20 THEN true
    ELSE false
  END AS in_top20,
  CASE
    WHEN rank_bottom <= 20 THEN true
    ELSE false
  END AS in_bottom20
FROM
  ranked

columns.description: Units in the selected planning-unit level with no hospital recorded (NHFR).
columns.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `has_hospital` = false THEN `area_name` END)

datasets.name: by_poverty_band
datasets.displayName: P3 Health workers per 10,000 by poverty band
queryLines:
SELECT
  poverty_band,
  count(*) AS units,
  round(
    sum(doctors)
      * 10000.0
      / sum(
        CASE
          WHEN doctors IS NOT NULL THEN population
        END
      ),
    2
  ) AS doctors_per_10k,
  round(
    sum(nurses)
      * 10000.0
      / sum(
        CASE
          WHEN nurses IS NOT NULL THEN population
        END
      ),
    2
  ) AS nurses_per_10k,
  round(
    sum(midwives)
      * 10000.0
      / sum(
        CASE
          WHEN midwives IS NOT NULL THEN population
        END
      ),
    2
  ) AS midwives_per_10k,
  round(
    sum(beds)
      * 10000.0
      / sum(
        CASE
          WHEN beds IS NOT NULL THEN population
        END
      ),
    2
  ) AS beds_per_10k,
  round(
    sum(government_beds)
      * 100.0
      / sum(
        CASE
          WHEN government_beds IS NOT NULL THEN beds
        END
      ),
    1
  ) AS government_bed_share_pct
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_area_service_profile
WHERE
  poverty_band IS NOT NULL
  AND population > 0
GROUP BY
  poverty_band

datasets.name: rank_stability
datasets.displayName: P3 TB ranking stability across weight sets
queryLines:
SELECT
  area_name,
  max(
    CASE
      WHEN weight_set = 'equal' THEN rank
    END
  ) AS rank_equal,
  max(
    CASE
      WHEN weight_set = 'supply_heavy' THEN rank
    END
  ) AS rank_supply_heavy,
  max(
    CASE
      WHEN weight_set = 'equity_heavy' THEN rank
    END
  ) AS rank_equity_heavy
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_area_priority
WHERE
  burden_indicator_key = 'tb_all_forms:cases:doh_fhsis'
  AND eligibility_config = 'complete_only'
  AND rank IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  area_name
HAVING
  least(rank_equal, rank_supply_heavy, rank_equity_heavy) <= 15
ORDER BY
  rank_equal

datasets.name: priority_tb
datasets.displayName: P3 High TB burden with gaps (equal weights, rescale_missing)
queryLines:
SELECT
  rank,
  area_name,
  unit_level,
  burden_rate_per_100k,
  gap_profile,
  flags_count,
  indicators_available,
  missing_indicators
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_area_priority
WHERE
  burden_indicator_key = 'tb_all_forms:cases:doh_fhsis'
  AND weight_set = 'equal'
  AND eligibility_config = 'rescale_missing'
  AND rank IS NOT NULL
  AND is_high_burden
  AND flags_count > 0
ORDER BY
  rank

datasets.name: evidence_gaps
datasets.displayName: P3 Evidence gaps per indicator
queryLines:
SELECT
  indicator_group,
  CASE
    WHEN
      indicator_group = 'burden'
      AND indicator_key LIKE 'ihme%'
    THEN
      'IHME modelled burden (18 indicators)'
    ELSE indicator_key
  END AS indicator,
  count(DISTINCT planning_unit_key) AS units,
  round(100.0 * count_if(NOT value_available) / count(*), 1) AS pct_missing,
  array_join(array_sort(collect_set(exclusion_reason)), '; ') AS reasons
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_area_evidence
GROUP BY
  1,
  2
ORDER BY
  indicator_group,
  pct_missing DESC

datasets.name: poverty_vs_beds
datasets.displayName: P3 Poverty incidence vs beds per 10,000 (units)
queryLines:
SELECT
  area_name,
  unit_level,
  poverty_incidence_pct,
  beds_per_10k,
  population
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_area_service_profile
WHERE
  poverty_incidence_pct IS NOT NULL
  AND beds_per_10k IS NOT NULL
  AND population > 0

datasets.name: dialysis_claims_vs_stations
datasets.displayName: P4 Dialysis claims vs stations per 100,000 (2024)
queryLines:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT
    area_key,
    sum(value) AS claims_paid
  FROM
    public_health.gold.v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    metric_name = 'claims_paid'
    AND coverage_basis = 'facility_location_province_excl_huc'
    AND year = 2024
    AND value_status = 'ok'
    AND lower(disease_name) LIKE '%dialysis%'
  GROUP BY
    area_key
)
SELECT
  k.area_name,
  k.dialysis_stations_per_100k,
  k.ckd_deaths_per_100k,
  k.population,
  round(c.claims_paid / k.population * 100000, 1) AS dialysis_claims_per_100k
FROM
  public_health.gold.mart_kidney_case_study AS k
    JOIN c
      ON c.area_key = k.kidney_unit_key
WHERE
  k.comparison_eligible

datasets.name: kpi_top10_share
datasets.displayName: KPI top-10 causes share of registered deaths 2024 (PSA)
queryLines:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT
    sum(value) AS all_causes
  FROM
    public_health.gold.v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'psa_deaths_region_annual'
    AND metric_name = 'deaths'
    AND disease_code = 'all_causes'
    AND geographic_level = 'country'
    AND year = 2024
    AND value_status = 'ok'
),
causes AS (
  -- Leaf causes only, same level as the top-10 bar chart: PSA 3-digit codes
  -- with the 19 ICD-chapter group headers excluded, letter-suffixed sub-causes
  -- excluded, and the COVID-19 breakdown codes excluded (psa_covid19 kept).
  SELECT
    disease_code,
    sum(value) AS deaths
  FROM
    public_health.gold.v_disease_metric_totals
  WHERE
    source_dataset = 'psa_deaths_region_annual'
    AND metric_name = 'deaths'
    AND geographic_level = 'country'
    AND year = 2024
    AND value_status = 'ok'
    AND disease_code <> 'all_causes'
    AND disease_code NOT IN (
      'psa_1_001',
      'psa_1_026',
      'psa_1_048',
      'psa_1_051',
      'psa_1_055',
      'psa_1_058',
      'psa_1_062',
      'psa_1_063',
      'psa_1_064',
      'psa_1_072',
      'psa_1_078',
      'psa_1_082',
      'psa_1_083',
      'psa_1_084',
      'psa_1_087',
      'psa_1_092',
      'psa_1_093',
      'psa_1_094',
      'psa_1_095'
    )
    AND disease_code NOT RLIKE '^psa_1_[0-9]{3}[a-z]$'
    AND disease_code NOT IN (
      'psa_covid19_vaccine_adverse_effects',
      'psa_covid19_virus_identified',
      'psa_covid19_virus_not_identified',
      'psa_mis_covid19',
      'psa_post_covid19_condition'
    )
  GROUP BY
    disease_code
),
t AS (
  SELECT
    sum(deaths) AS top10
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        deaths
      FROM
        causes
      ORDER BY
        deaths DESC
      LIMIT 10
    )
)
SELECT
  round(t.top10 / a.all_causes, 4) AS top10_share_ratio,
  round(100.0 * t.top10 / a.all_causes, 1) AS top10_share_pct,
  t.top10,
  a.all_causes
FROM
  t CROSS JOIN a

    )

SELECT v.disease_name, v.deaths,

config.source:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT area_name, MAX(tb_notifications_per_100k_2025) AS disease_rate_per_100k
  FROM public_health.gold.mart_tb_case_study
  WHERE comparison_eligible AND tb_notifications_per_100k_2025 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY area_name
),
s AS (
  SELECT area_name, beds_per_10k, poverty_incidence_pct
  FROM public_health.gold.mart_area_service_profile
  WHERE unit_level = 'province' AND beds_per_10k IS NOT NULL AND population > 0
),
j AS (
  SELECT t.area_name, t.disease_rate_per_100k, s.beds_per_10k, s.poverty_incidence_pct
  FROM t JOIN s ON s.area_name = t.area_name
),
r AS (
  SELECT j.*,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE(disease_rate_per_100k, 0.5) OVER (), 1) AS median_disease_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY disease_rate_per_100k DESC, area_name) AS rank_disease,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY beds_per_10k ASC, area_name) AS rank_beds_inverse,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY poverty_incidence_pct DESC, area_name) AS rank_poverty,
    (disease_rate_per_100k > PERCENTILE(disease_rate_per_100k, 0.5) OVER ()
      AND beds_per_10k < 10) AS is_priority
  FROM j
)
SELECT area_name, disease_rate_per_100k, beds_per_10k, poverty_incidence_pct,
       rank_disease, rank_beds_inverse, rank_poverty,
       rank_disease + rank_beds_inverse + rank_poverty AS gap_score,
       median_disease_rate, is_priority,
       rank_disease <= 10 AS in_top10_tb
FROM r
config.comment: TB notification rate per 100k (FHSIS 2025) above the national median AND beds per 10k below the 10 benchmark; gap score = incidence rank + inverse beds rank + poverty rank.

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT year AS yr FROM (
    SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT area_key) AS areas
    FROM public_health.gold.v_disease_metric_totals
    WHERE disease_code = 'dengue' AND source_dataset = 'hdx_dengue' AND metric_name = 'cases'
      AND value_status = 'ok' AND geographic_level = 'province'
    GROUP BY year
  )
  WHERE rows_cnt >= areas * 40
  ORDER BY year DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
acm AS (
  SELECT area_key, MAX(area_name) AS area_name, MAX(REPLACE(area_code, 'psgc:', '')) AS psgc_code
  FROM public_health.gold.area_coverage_map
  WHERE area_key IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT area_key FROM public_health.gold.v_disease_metric_totals
    WHERE disease_code = 'dengue' AND source_dataset = 'hdx_dengue' AND metric_name = 'cases'
      AND value_status = 'ok' AND geographic_level = 'province')
  GROUP BY area_key
),
c AS (
  SELECT v.area_key, SUM(v.value) AS cases
  FROM public_health.gold.v_disease_metric_totals v
  WHERE v.disease_code = 'dengue' AND v.source_dataset = 'hdx_dengue' AND v.metric_name = 'cases'
    AND v.value_status = 'ok' AND v.geographic_level = 'province'
    AND v.year = (SELECT yr FROM latest)
  GROUP BY 1
),
p AS (
  SELECT REPLACE(area_code, 'psgc:', '') AS psgc_code, MAX(area_name) AS province_name, SUM(population) AS population
  FROM public_health.gold.mart_area_service_profile
  WHERE unit_level = 'province' AND population > 0
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  p.province_name,
  c.cases,
  p.population,
  ROUND(c.cases * 100000.0 / p.population, 1) AS incidence_per_100k,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ROUND(c.cases * 100000.0 / p.population, 1) DESC) AS rnk,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ROUND(c.cases * 100000.0 / p.population, 1) DESC) <= 10 AS in_top10
FROM c
JOIN acm ON acm.area_key = c.area_key
JOIN p ON p.psgc_code = acm.psgc_code
WHERE p.population > 0
